department: Faculty of Science — Department of Physics

deadline.value: Main Round and Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (1st Clearing Round: April 30, 2027; 2nd Clearing Round: August 31, 2027).

also.quote: In view of the limited admission quota, applicants are strongly encouraged to apply in the Main Round. Applications will be considered in the clearing rounds only if there are vacancies after the Main Round.

gre_subject.value: Not required for STEM PhD programs (GRE Subject Test in Psychology >= 550 is required only for Department of Psychology applicants whose first degree is not in Psychology; GRE General/GMAT is required only for Business and Economics).
gre_subject.quote: Faculty of Business and Economics applicants are required to demonstrate their capability for graduate studies by obtaining satisfactory scores in the Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) or Graduate Record Examinations (GRE), taken within five years | Department of Psychology applicants whose first degree is not in Psychology are required to obtain a minimum score of 550 in the GRE’s Subject Test in Psychology taken within five years

supervisor.value: Students are encouraged to contact prospective supervisors directly to obtain detailed project information.
supervisor.quote: Students are encouraged to contact their prospective supervisors directly to obtain the further detailed information of the project.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students with 2:1 honours (or equivalent) or above are normally considered eligible to receive a Postgraduate Scholarship (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after confirmation, wef 1/9/2026).
funding.quote: Full-time MPhil and PhD students who hold a first degree with second-class honours first division (or equivalent) or above are normally considered eligible to receive a Postgraduate Scholarship (HK$19,135 per month) during the normative study period.

also.quote: A PGS holder whose PhD probationary candidature has been confirmed will receive a higher PGS rate (HK$19,655, wef 1/9/2026)

entry_route.value: Admits good honours bachelor's and/or taught master's holders to the 4-year PhD, and research master's (e.g., MPhil) holders to the 3-year PhD.
entry_route.quote: The University offers 3-year and 4-year PhD programmes. Applicants who have a good Bachelor’s degree with honours and/or a taught Master’s degree will be considered for admission to a 4-year PhD programme, whereas those who already hold a research Master’s degree (e.g. MPhil) will only be considered for admission to a 3-year PhD programme.
